_meta: Agents intentionally without autonomous runtime inside the repo (schedule/CronJob/workflow). Each entry must carry a short rationale. The fleet-autonomy-audit script reads this file; adding an agent here silences it. Remove an agent from this list if a schedule gets added. Entries prefixed with 'HOST-CRON:' mean the runtime lives in the founder's host crontab (see ~/.claude/tools/).
adversarial-behavior-analyst-agent: Red-team specialist — invoked on demand during adversarial reviews; no recurring workload.
agent-trainer-agent: Coordinated by continuous-improvement-coordinator-agent; does not own its own schedule.
ai-platform-architect: Reactive reviewer on architecture PRs; no recurring workload.
api-designer: Reactive reviewer on API contract PRs; no recurring workload.
architecture-adr-writer: Reactive writer triggered by architecture decisions; no recurring workload.
chaos-engineering-agent: Runs pre-certification exercises on-demand, not on a schedule.
clinical-triage-agent: Advisory-only; driven by clinical workflow events, not scheduled cron.
customer-onboarding-agent: Triggered by new-customer intake events, not a schedule.
eks-operator: Reactive operator for EKS lifecycle tasks, invoked on demand.
external-secrets-specialist-agent: Reactive specialist invoked when ESO changes land.
gap-analysis-agent: Invoked on demand during roadmap reviews.
gitops-operator: Reactive operator for ArgoCD lifecycle tasks, invoked on demand.
hospital-chart-review-agent: Advisory-only; runs inside clinical workflows, not on schedule.
hospital-claim-denial-agent: Event-driven on glosa arrival; not a schedule.
hospital-discharge-summary-agent: Event-driven at discharge, not a schedule.
hospital-insurance-preauth-agent: Event-driven on pre-auth request, not a schedule.
hospital-lab-results-agent: Event-driven on new DiagnosticReport, not a schedule.
hospital-scheduling-agent: Event-driven on slot requests, not a schedule.
infra-planner: Reactive planner invoked during infra design sessions.
market-intelligence-manager: Orchestrates market scans through web-research-agent; no direct schedule.
marketing-copy-agent: Invoked on copy/UX PRs and by ui-audit; no recurring workload.
product-analytics-agent: Driven by analytics pipeline events; no direct schedule.
runtime-failure-analyst-agent: Invoked by incident reviews, not scheduled.
soc-alert-triage-agent: Driven by SIEM/EDR alert events, not a cron schedule.
soc-cti-aggregator-agent: Driven by feed ingestion events; aggregation pipeline owns its own schedule.
soc-ioc-management-agent: IOC lifecycle driven by feed updates and distribution events.
soc-log-ingestion-agent: Pipeline ingestion worker; cadence owned by pipeline operator.
soc-pentest-automation-agent: Runs against pre-authorized targets on engagement schedule, not global cron.
soc-soar-orchestration-agent: Triggered by incident playbooks; no own cron.
soc-vulnerability-management-agent: Driven by scanner events; prioritization work on intake, not cron.
temporal-specialist-agent: Reactive specialist on workflow code PRs.
